papers.title: Diffusion TV: Experiencing Diffusion Models through Tangible, Embodied Interaction
papers.abstract: Diffusion TV is an interactive AI art installation that offers a tangible and embodied experience of diffusion models through a modified CRT TV. By physically manipulating the TV's antenna, audiences control the clarity of AI-generated images and sounds, metaphorically enacting the denoising process that underlies diffusion-based generation. Using the tuning knob, participants switch between three channels featuring AI-generated animals from the Past (extinct species), Present (endangered species), and Future (speculative creatures), situating the interaction within a temporal and ecological narrative. Through continuous audiovisual feedback and physical interaction, Diffusion TV foregrounds the generative process over final outputs, allowing audiences to explore intermediate states as experiential material. Rather than providing explicit technical explanation, the work presents an alternative, embodied mode of explainable AI that invites exploratory engagement with and reflection on generative technologies.
papers.summary_zh: 扩散模型的可解释性通常依赖技术说明，缺乏直观体验。该作品通过改造CRT电视，让观众用物理天线操作模拟去噪过程，并切换过去、现在、未来三个生态主题频道。它提供了一种具身化的可解释AI方式，将生成过程本身作为艺术体验材料，促进对生成技术的反思。
papers.summary_en: Diffusion models are often explained through technical descriptions, lacking intuitive understanding. This work presents an interactive art installation using a modified CRT TV, where physically manipulating the antenna lets audiences embody the denoising process and switch between ecological-themed channels of the past, present, and future. It offers an embodied mode of explainable AI, foregrounding the generative process as experiential material and inviting reflective engagement with the technology.
highlights_zh: 具身交互解释扩散模型去噪
物理天线控制图像清晰度
以艺术形式促进AI技术反思

papers.title: RegionFed: Federated Learning for Personalized Query Understanding in Heterogeneous Retail Environments
papers.abstract: Retail search systems serve diverse geographic regions with distinct query patterns, vocabularies, and product preferences, creating significant data heterogeneity that challenges both privacy-preserving training and model personalization. Federated learning offers a natural solution for privacy, but standard FL methods produce global models that sacrifice regional performance, while existing personalized FL approaches operate at the parameter level and catastrophically collapse on modern transformers (below 10\% accuracy on T5) due to tied embeddings and LayerNorm interactions. We introduce RegionFed, an \textit{architecture-robust} federated learning framework that sidesteps this failure by operating entirely at the gradient level. RegionFed uses the $\ell_2$ conflict between regional and global gradients as a unified signal that (i) diagnoses heterogeneity, (ii) routes each region to the cheapest sufficient personalization strategy, and (iii) adaptively controls personalization strength. Because it treats models as differentiable black boxes, RegionFed deploys on T5-Small, T5-3B, RoBERTa, and CNN with zero code changes, providing large gains on transformers (where parameter-level methods collapse) and consistent improvements on CNNs. Across three public datasets (Amazon ESCI, Amazon Reviews, LEAF-FEMNIST) and four architectures, RegionFed-Meta achieves 92.27\%, closing the gap to the privacy-violating centralized upper bound (Centralized + Regional Weighting: 92.04\%, $Δ$=0.23pp, within 1$σ$) while providing $(ε{\approx}0.60)$-differential privacy and $\mathcal{O}(1/\sqrt{T})$ convergence.
papers.summary_zh: 零售搜索系统面临跨区域数据异构和隐私保护挑战，标准联邦学习全局模型牺牲区域性能，而现有参数级个性化方法在Transformer上因嵌入和LayerNorm交互而崩溃。RegionFed提出架构鲁棒的梯度级联邦学习框架，利用区域与全局梯度的ℓ2冲突作为统一信号来诊断异构性、路由个性化策略并自适应控制强度。RegionFed-Meta在T5等模型上达到92.27%准确率，接近集中式上界（差距0.23pp），同时提供差分隐私和O(1/√T)收敛保证。
papers.summary_en: Retail search systems face data heterogeneity across regions and privacy constraints, where standard federated learning sacrifices regional performance and parameter-level personalization collapses on modern transformers due to tied embeddings and LayerNorm. RegionFed introduces an architecture-robust framework operating entirely at the gradient level, using ℓ2 conflict between regional and global gradients as a unified signal for heterogeneity diagnosis, routing, and adaptive personalization control. RegionFed-Meta achieves 92.27% accuracy on T5, closing the gap to the centralized upper bound (Δ=0.23pp, within 1σ) while providing differential privacy and O(1/√T) convergence.
highlights_zh: 梯度级个性化，架构无关
T5达92.27%，逼近集中式上界
零代码适配多架构，隐私安全

papers.title: UniMate: One Unified Model to Animate Diverse Skeletons
papers.abstract: Recent advances in automatic rigging now deliver animation-ready 3D assets at scale, yet generating the motion to drive them remains a bottleneck. Existing learned animators are topology-constrained: they rely on category-specific templates or require per-skeleton fine-tuning and reference motions at inference. We present UniMate, a unified foundation model that synthesizes articulated motion for arbitrary skeletons from a rigged 3D asset and a text prompt, with no test-time optimization or per-skeleton retraining. UniMate introduces a topology-aware diffusion transformer, which integrates skeletal topology into attention via three mechanisms: (1) a graph-aware attention bias from pairwise joint relations and geodesic distances; (2) a spectral rotary position embedding generalizing RoPE to arbitrary kinematic trees via the graph Laplacian; and (3) a global topological conditioner attention-pooled from the rest-pose skeleton. We also curate UniML3D, 13,006 motion sequences spanning bipedal, quadrupedal, avian, marine, insectoid, serpentine, and articulated rigid objects with unified canonicalization and text pairing. Trained on this dataset, UniMate outperforms state-of-the-art baselines in quality, generalization, and efficiency, and supports zero-shot cross-topology transfer, in-betweening, expansion, and text-guided editing. Our project page is available at https://linzhanmou.com/unimate/.
papers.summary_zh: 自动绑定技术已能大规模生成可动画3D资产，但驱动这些资产的运动生成仍受限于骨架拓扑，现有方法依赖类别模板或需逐骨架微调。UniMate提出统一基础模型，通过拓扑感知扩散Transformer（含图感知注意力偏置、谱旋转位置编码和全局拓扑条件器）实现任意骨架从文本提示生成动画，无需测试时优化。在自建UniML3D数据集上训练后，UniMate在质量、泛化性和效率上超越现有方法，并支持零样本跨拓扑迁移、补间、扩展和文本引导编辑。
papers.summary_en: Automatic rigging now produces animation-ready 3D assets at scale, but generating motion to drive them remains bottlenecked by skeleton topology constraints, requiring category-specific templates or per-skeleton fine-tuning. UniMate introduces a unified foundation model with a topology-aware diffusion transformer, integrating graph-aware attention bias, spectral rotary position embedding, and global topological conditioning to synthesize motion for arbitrary skeletons from text prompts without test-time optimization. Trained on UniML3D (13,006 sequences across diverse skeleton types), UniMate outperforms state-of-the-art baselines in quality, generalization, and efficiency, enabling zero-shot cross-topology transfer, in-betweening, expansion, and text-guided editing.
highlights_zh: 拓扑感知扩散Transformer
跨任意骨架零样本动画生成
自建13K多骨架运动数据集

papers.title: Distill Globally, Adapt Locally: Reasoning Distillation and Product-Type Test-Time Training for Scalable Trade-Up Recommendation
papers.abstract: Trade-up recommendation identifies higher-quality alternatives that preserve a customer's purchase intent while offering upgraded benefits. Large language models (LLMs) can reason about such distinctions, but applying them directly to hundreds of millions of product pairs is operationally impractical. We introduce a two-level framework that distills LLM reasoning into an efficient non-generative student and adapts its decision boundary to product-type-specific trade-up criteria. At Level 1, a retrieval-augmented few-shot LLM teacher generates structured relation labels and natural-language rationales. These rationales supervise a compact embedding-pair classifier through alignment and contrastive objectives; at inference, the student uses only two precomputed 768-dimensional product embeddings, with no LLM calls or text generation. On a fixed human-annotated benchmark of 8,352 pairs, a 15.5M-parameter four-class reasoning-distilled student achieves AUC 0.924 (95% CI [0.918, 0.929]), compared with 0.912 for the four-class label-only student. At Level 2, product-type test-time training (PT-TTT) uses few-shot demonstrations to optimize lightweight category-specific adapters over the frozen student. PT-TTT improves AUC from 0.924 to 0.941 and average precision from 0.920 to 0.940. On a 100K-pair proxy catalog, the distilled student on a single eight-GPU machine is approximately 5,000x faster and 10,000x lower in estimated cost than direct LLM inference.
papers.summary_zh: 贸易升级推荐需在保留购买意图的同时推荐更优质商品，但直接使用大语言模型处理海量产品对在算力和成本上不可行。本文提出两层级框架：先用LLM教师生成推理标签和自然语言理由，蒸馏出紧凑的嵌入对分类器，再通过产品类型测试时训练（PT-TTT）用少量示例优化轻量级类别适配器。蒸馏学生模型在8352对人类标注基准上AUC达0.924，PT-TTT将其提升至0.941，且推理速度比直接LLM推理快约5000倍、成本低约10000倍。
papers.summary_en: Trade-up recommendation aims to suggest higher-quality alternatives preserving purchase intent, but applying large language models directly to hundreds of millions of product pairs is impractical. We propose a two-level framework that distills LLM reasoning into a compact embedding-pair classifier via alignment and contrastive objectives, then adapts its decision boundary using product-type test-time training with few-shot demonstrations. The distilled student achieves AUC 0.924 on a human-annotated benchmark, improved to 0.941 by PT-TTT, while being approximately 5,000x faster and 10,000x cheaper than direct LLM inference.
highlights_zh: 两层级蒸馏+测试时训练框架
AUC达0.941，较标签蒸馏提升0.017
推理快5000倍，成本低万倍

papers.title: WearableQA: A Benchmark for Health Reasoning over Real-World Wearable Data
papers.abstract: Recent advances in wearable sensing enable continuous monitoring of physiological and behavioral signals, yet existing benchmarks rarely evaluate whether AI systems can reason over a real user's longitudinal wearable record. We introduce WearableQA, a benchmark comprising 4,084 10-option multiple-choice questions constructed from the wearable time series, blood biomarkers, and demographics of 200 real users, each with up to 500 days of daily measurements. WearableQA preserves authentic wearable distributions that include device noise and inter-individual variability. To evaluate distinct reasoning capabilities, we introduce 16 question types organized along two complementary axes: data versus health reasoning, which distinguishes computation over longitudinal measurements from physiological interpretation; and single- versus cross-signal reasoning, which separates reasoning about individual signals from the integration of multiple signals. To construct reliable questions at scale, we adopt a dual-grounding framework that combines literature-grounded physiological findings with statistically validated population-grounded physiological patterns. This enables the capture of meaningful relationships observed in real-world wearable data. Evaluation of 14 proprietary and open-source LLMs demonstrates that WearableQA effectively differentiates model capabilities, with performance ranging from 19.6% to 72.9% against a 10% chance baseline. Moreover, WearableQA remains far from solved: most models achieve accuracies below 60%. Overall, WearableQA provides a realistic and diagnostic benchmark for evaluating LLM reasoning over real-world wearable data.
papers.summary_zh: 现有基准很少评估AI系统对真实用户长期可穿戴数据的推理能力。我们提出WearableQA基准，包含来自200名真实用户的4084道多选题，并通过双锚定框架构建16种问题类型以区分数据与健康推理、单信号与跨信号推理。评估14种LLM显示性能从19.6%到72.9%，多数模型准确率低于60%，表明该基准有效且尚未被解决。
papers.summary_en: Existing benchmarks rarely evaluate AI reasoning over real users' longitudinal wearable data. We introduce WearableQA, a benchmark with 4,084 questions from 200 real users, featuring 16 question types via a dual-grounding framework to distinguish data vs. health and single- vs. cross-signal reasoning. Evaluation of 14 LLMs shows performance from 19.6% to 72.9%, with most below 60%, demonstrating effective differentiation and remaining unsolved.
highlights_zh: 真实可穿戴数据推理基准
多数模型准确率低于60%
评估健康推理与信号整合

papers.title: Same Trajectory, Contradictory Rewards (ROBORMBENCH): Paraphrase Fragility in Vision Language Reward Models
papers.abstract: Vision-language models are increasingly used as reward functions for robotic learning, but this role requires paraphrase invariance: the same trajectory should receive the same reward under semantically equivalent goal descriptions. We show that current VLM reward models often violate this property. Paraphrasing the instruction alone can substantially change predicted progress scores, and can even flip identical robot behavior between failure and success. To measure this failure mode, we introduce ROBORMBENCH, a benchmark with 2,390 real-robot trajectories, ground-truth progress labels, and 21,673 verified paraphrases spanning lexical, syntactic, and action-goal rewrites. Across proprietary and open-source VLMs, paraphrase-induced instability is widespread and severe, grows under more divergent rewrites, and is not reliably reduced by scale or explicit reasoning. Dedicated reward models trained with trajectory-grounded supervision are substantially more stable. These results show that paraphrase robustness is a core requirement for reliable VLM-based reward modeling in robotics.
papers.summary_zh: 视觉语言模型作为机器人奖励函数时缺乏释义不变性，相同轨迹在语义等价指令下可能获得矛盾奖励。为此提出ROBORMBENCH基准，包含2,390条真实机器人轨迹和21,673个验证过的释义改写。实验表明该不稳定现象普遍且严重，而基于轨迹监督训练的专用奖励模型显著更稳定。
papers.summary_en: Vision-language reward models for robotics lack paraphrase invariance, giving contradictory rewards for the same trajectory under semantically equivalent instructions. We introduce ROBORMBENCH with 2,390 real-robot trajectories and 21,673 verified paraphrases to quantify this failure mode. Results show widespread instability across VLMs that scale and reasoning fail to fix, while trajectory-grounded reward models are substantially more robust.
highlights_zh: 首个机器人奖励模型释义鲁棒性基准
2,390条真实轨迹与21,673个释义
专用奖励模型显著更稳定

papers.title: WorldSculpt: Generating Compositional Worlds from Grounded Videos
papers.abstract: We study the problem of generating a compositional 3D representation of a cluttered scene containing hundreds of objects. The goal is to represent the scene as a collection of individual object meshes placed in a shared world frame, as required by downstream applications such as gaming, AR/VR, simulation, and robotics. This task is challenging in densely cluttered scenes, where objects heavily occlude one another and each view reveals only a fraction of their geometry. Geometry-based approaches typically reconstruct the scene as a single representation and leave incomplete geometry in occluded regions, while existing compositional methods with generative priors are largely limited to relatively simple scenes. We show that complex scenes with hundreds of objects can instead be generated compositionally by adapting a strong single-object 3D generative prior to multi-view observations. We instantiate this paradigm with Pixal3D, extending it with a multi-view conditioning pathway that grounds object generation in multiple posed observations. Although the model is finetuned entirely on single objects in canonical space, it generalizes to large scenes with severe occlusion without any scene-level training, demonstrating the feasibility and scalability of this paradigm. We further introduce UE-MeshyScene, a photorealistic benchmark of densely cluttered scenes with hundreds of objects, per-object annotations, and ground-truth meshes. Across single-object, controlled multi-object, and UE-MeshyScene evaluations, our method consistently outperforms prior approaches, with larger gains as scene complexity and occlusion increase. Finally, we demonstrate broader applicability by converting generated 3DGS worlds, such as Marble and HY-World 2.0, into compositional mesh scenes.
papers.summary_zh: 该论文研究从多视角视频中生成包含数百个物体的组合式3D场景表示，挑战在于严重遮挡导致单视角几何信息不完整。方法创新性地将单物体3D生成先验模型Pixal3D扩展为多视角条件路径，在单物体规范空间微调后无需场景级训练即可泛化到复杂场景。实验在自建基准UE-MeshyScene上显著优于现有方法，并能将3DGS世界转换为组合式网格场景。
papers.summary_en: This paper tackles compositional 3D scene generation with hundreds of heavily occluded objects from multi-view videos. The method adapts a strong single-object generative prior (Pixal3D) with a multi-view conditioning pathway, trained only on single objects yet generalizing to complex scenes without scene-level fine-tuning. It outperforms prior methods on a new benchmark (UE-MeshyScene) and converts existing 3DGS worlds into compositional meshes, showing strong scalability.
highlights_zh: 单物体先验泛化至复杂场景
UE-MeshyScene基准上显著领先
支持3DGS场景转组合网格

papers.title: A Generalizable Feature Extractor for Alzheimer's-Related Brain MRI Tasks
papers.abstract: When there is not enough labeled data to properly train deep learning models, transfer learning can help. We still do not fully understand how effective it is in neuroimaging, especially for Alzheimer's disease research. It is also not clear if these transferred models can work on new datasets without being retrained for each specific task. We evaluate whether a compact, supervised pretrained model can serve as a reusable foundation model for downstream neuroimaging tasks. We freeze the 7.18 million weights of a 3D CNN previously trained for brain-age prediction, and adapt it to each task using Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA), requiring only ~1% additional trainable parameters. We evaluate generalizability in six experiments. Adapting the model to classify cognitively normal versus Dementia on ADNI gave an AUC of 0.964 on held-out folds (Experiment #1). Applying that adapted model unchanged to OASIS-3, with no retraining, gave an AUC of 0.871 (Experiment #2). Reusing its output logit together with age and a cognitive score distinguished stable from progressing MCI with an AUC of 0.828 (Experiment #3). Adapting the same backbone to predict amyloid positivity from structural MRI gave an AUC of 0.804 (Experiment #4). Finally, the same approach estimated ICV-normalized hippocampal and white matter hypointensity volumes directly from the T1w image, with R^2 of 0.80 and 0.91 respectively, tasks normally addressed with much larger U-Net networks (Experiments #5 and #6). A compact model supervised on brain age can therefore serve as a reusable backbone, adapting to each task with ~1% additional parameters and transferring to an unseen cohort without any training. Our findings suggest that a carefully trained brain age model can serve as an effective foundation model for Alzheimer's related tasks, even under strict data constraints.
papers.summary_zh: 阿尔茨海默病相关脑MRI任务常面临标注数据不足的问题，迁移学习的有效性尚不明确。本文提出将预训练于脑龄预测的紧凑3D CNN作为冻结主干，仅用约1%可训练参数通过LoRA适配各下游任务。模型在六个实验中表现优异，并能零训练迁移至新数据集，表明脑龄模型可作为有效的通用基础模型。
papers.summary_en: Transfer learning for Alzheimer's-related brain MRI tasks is underexplored, especially under limited labeled data. This paper freezes a compact 3D CNN pretrained for brain-age prediction and adapts it to downstream tasks via LoRA with only ~1% trainable parameters. Results across six experiments show strong performance and zero-training transfer to unseen cohorts, highlighting its potential as a reusable foundation model.
highlights_zh: 冻结主干+LoRA适配，仅需1%参数
跨数据集零训练迁移AUC达0.871
可替代大网络完成体积回归任务

papers.title: CrossDepth: Geometry-Constrained Attention for Generalizable Multi-View Surround Depth Estimation
papers.abstract: Reliable 3D understanding of the surrounding environment is a core requirement for autonomous driving. Multi-view surround camera rigs provide broad scene coverage, but the spatially adjacent images typically overlap only minimally. Consequently, the depth of most pixels must be inferred from monocular appearance cues. These cues can appear differently across images and may therefore be interpreted differently by the depth estimation model. We target two main sources of cross-image inconsistency: differences in camera intrinsics and the limited receptive field of each image. We address the former by conditioning the features on per-pixel camera-aware ray embeddings, enabling the network to account for camera-dependent variations in monocular cues. We address the latter by extending each pixel's context beyond its own image through cross-image attention constrained to geometrically plausible regions, derived from the calibrated rig setup. The model is trained in a fully self-supervised manner based on photometric consistency. Evaluations on DDAD and nuScenes show improved overall depth accuracy and cross-image depth consistency over state-of-the-art self-supervised methods under in-domain and cross-domain evaluation. Code is available at https://abualhanud.github.io/CrossDepthPage/.
papers.summary_zh: 多视角环绕相机深度估计面临跨图像不一致问题，源于相机内参差异和有限感受野。提出CrossDepth方法，通过像素级相机感知射线嵌入和几何约束的跨图像注意力来分别解决这两个问题，并采用自监督光度一致性训练。在DDAD和nuScenes数据集上，该方法在域内和跨域评估中均提升了深度精度和跨图像一致性，优于现有自监督方法。
papers.summary_en: Multi-view surround depth estimation suffers from cross-image inconsistencies due to camera intrinsic differences and limited receptive fields. CrossDepth addresses these by conditioning features on per-pixel camera-aware ray embeddings and applying cross-image attention constrained to geometrically plausible regions from the calibrated rig, trained with self-supervised photometric consistency. Evaluations on DDAD and nuScenes show improved depth accuracy and cross-image consistency over state-of-the-art self-supervised methods in both in-domain and cross-domain settings.
highlights_zh: 几何约束跨图像注意力
域内外精度均超SOTA
自监督，适配多相机系统

papers.title: What Matters, When? Diagnosing and Improving Conditional Visual Grounding in Visuomotor Imitation Policies
papers.abstract: Visuomotor imitation policies can achieve high performance under in-distribution visual conditions yet fail when visually similar objects or receptacles are introduced. We study this behavior as a problem of conditional visual grounding: the visual target required for successful control changes with the manipulation phase and, in more complex tasks, with the observed task state. Using Action Chunking with Transformers (ACT), we systematically introduce distractor objects and receptacles with controlled color and shape similarity and localize failures to picking and placement. We find that distractor sensitivity is specific to both the type of visual similarity and the manipulation stage. Guided by this diagnosis, we evaluate distractor augmentation, phase-dependent attention regularization, and appearance-based visual prompting as complementary interventions for improving target selection while preserving spatial information required for control. These interventions substantially improve robustness in simulation and on a physical UR3e. We further examine the same failure pattern in a pretrained vision-language-action policy on a state-conditioned instrument-handling task, where the observed state of a medical instrument determines the correct destination. Together, the results show that visual distractors can cause incorrect object or destination selection even when the underlying manipulation skill remains intact, and that explicitly improving target selection can substantially recover performance across distinct visuomotor policy-learning regimes.
papers.summary_zh: 视觉运动模仿策略在分布内条件下表现良好，但遇到视觉相似干扰物或容器时容易失败，这被归结为条件视觉接地问题。本文使用ACT策略系统诊断了干扰物敏感性与操作阶段和视觉相似类型的关系，并提出干扰物增强、阶段依赖注意力正则化和外观视觉提示三种干预方法。这些方法在仿真和真实UR3e机器人上显著提升了目标选择鲁棒性，并在预训练视觉语言动作策略上验证了其通用性。
papers.summary_en: Visuomotor imitation policies fail under visually similar distractors due to poor conditional visual grounding. This work diagnoses failure patterns in ACT policies and proposes distractor augmentation, phase-dependent attention regularization, and appearance-based visual prompting. These interventions substantially improve robustness in simulation and on a physical UR3e, and generalize to a pretrained vision-language-action policy.
highlights_zh: 诊断并改进条件视觉接地
仿真与实物UR3e鲁棒性显著提升
适用于ACT及VLA策略，具通用性
